report_metadata.report_name: Conversa AI — Nemotron Inference Reliability: Offline Fix Preparation

reasoning_inspection.finding: In the public OpenRouter model catalog, supported_efforts is completely omitted for nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free (unlike nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b which explicitly lists ['high', 'medium', 'none']). Consequently, support for effort: 'none' is ambiguous in the model catalog.

proposed_reasoning_controls.rule: Only include reasoning={'effort': 'none'} when model metadata explicitly confirms 'none' in supported_efforts and mandatory is False. If supported_efforts is omitted or ambiguous, omit reasoning configuration to avoid sending unverified provider parameters.
proposed_reasoning_controls.previous_flaw_addressed: Previous experiment sent reasoning={'enabled': False}, which is not an OpenRouter reasoning property and was silently ignored. reasoning.exclude=true is explicitly avoided because it only hides tokens from response without reducing generation token consumption.
proposed_reasoning_controls.ambiguity_handling: Reasoning effort support is ambiguous for nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free; reasoning parameter is omitted until upstream metadata explicitly declares supported_efforts.

system_prompt_before.rule_structure: 10 rules with 5 nested sub-bullets under rule 6; requested up to two suggestions.

system_prompt_after.rule_structure: 6 dense positive/negative rules; requests exactly ONE suggestion.

proposed_completion_budget.rationale: Experiment 2 completed in 830 completion tokens with finish_reason='stop' under max_tokens=1000 using a 178-word prompt. The failed canary (1,000 tokens) was triggered by prompt bloat (336 words) that expanded chain-of-thought beyond 710 tokens. By reducing the prompt by 52% and requesting 1 suggestion instead of 2, reasoning length is curtailed back into the safe 600-750 token window, fitting comfortably within 1,000 max_tokens without unnecessary token ceiling inflation.

key_functions: determine_reasoning_config: Evaluates model metadata and avoids blind parameter injection
build_canary_request_params: Enforces model ID, max_retries=0, and metadata-driven params
execute_canary_parse: Enforces allow_repair=False and handles StructuredOutputError

verification_areas.2_reasoning_config_metadata_driven: PASS (omits when ambiguous, applies when confirmed)
verification_areas.7_valid_json_and_tool_calls_parsed: PASS (valid JSON and tool_calls parsed cleanly)

remaining_uncertainties: Upstream provider reasoning variance: On OpenRouter's free tier, requests for nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free are dynamically routed among providers (e.g. NVIDIA NIM, Fireworks, DeepInfra). Some upstream providers may generate internal chain-of-thought tokens regardless of client request headers. Prompt conciseness is the primary mitigation.
